name: wl93d_checker_addendum_v1
class: WL93D POST-HOC QUALITATIVE ADDENDUM (non-numbered). Not part of the frozen WL93D protocol, evidence or labels; nothing here changes them.

frozen_inputs.checkpoints: WL92A own s8601 / s8602 (loaded through ops93d.load_family, unchanged); the WL93A T0 family is not rendered here
frozen_inputs.operator: ops93d.arm_eval / local_factors / global_term unchanged; arms C0, C2_src, C2_rcv, C2_both
frozen_inputs.renderer: pt86 (WL86) path tracer and ECRO lookup renderer; the only change is the material lookup at a surface hit (see texture.interface)
frozen_inputs.masks: WL86 E2 masks (geometry / visibility only; unchanged by albedo)

scene: E2 T1 (WL86 edit E2, light set as recorded in the fixture)

texture.surface: back wall (rectangle index 2, y = 2 m, normal -y; 16 x 12 patches of exactly 25 cm x 25 cm)
texture.pattern: patch-aligned checkerboard: patch (iu, iv) of the back wall gets material a if (iu + iv) is even, else b; one checker cell = one patch, so cell boundaries are patch boundaries
texture.interface: the texture is a per-patch MATERIAL-ID map PMAT. (i) learned ECRO: its only material input is mat_states[PMAT[patch]] (model86.factors), so it sees the per-patch state; (ii) M64: Mn = Mq[PMAT[patch]]; (iii) physical reference / LOW / ECRO renderer: at a back-wall hit the material id is PMAT[patch_bin(hit)] instead of the per-shape id (one inserted lookup in pt86.Ctx.trace, applied by source patch at run time; pt86.py itself is not edited)

variants.ck38: a = id 6 = Lambert 0.3, b = id 7 = Lambert 0.8; new rows built with the WL86 lambert_state constructor (reproduced bit-exactly on ids 3-5) and appended to the material table of the renderer and to the model's mat_states buffer (learned weights untouched). Albedos lie outside the Lambert range seen in training (0.5-0.7) -> MATERIAL-DISTRIBUTION TEST
variants.ck75: a = id 3 (walls, 0.7), b = id 4 (box A, 0.5): existing training-vocabulary states, new spatial distribution (box material on wall patches) -> MATERIAL-DISTRIBUTION TEST
variants.none: patched code path with the checker off (identity control only, not rendered at full budget)

texture.M64_new_rows: Mq rows for ids 6 / 7 = Mq[3] x (albedo / 0.7), admissible only if test T_mq shows the Lambert rows are exactly proportional to albedo

preflight_tests_stop_on_failure.T_buffer: each checkpoint's mat_states == mats86 states bit-exactly before extension; first 6 rows unchanged after extension
preflight_tests_stop_on_failure.T_closure: DrClosure83 on ids 3 / 6 / 7: eval(6) / 0.3 = eval(3) / 0.7 = eval(7) / 0.8 (rel <= 1e-5); sampled directions identical; sample weights = albedo (rel <= 1e-5)
preflight_tests_stop_on_failure.T_identity: variant none: patched renderer output == original renderer output bit-exactly (cam mode reference, ecro mode with a WL93D table; 128 x 128, 8 spp)
preflight_tests_stop_on_failure.T_tables: variant none: B tables == WL93D I_E2_T1 tables for own s8601 / s8602 and arms C0, C2_src, C2_rcv, C2_both (max abs diff <= 1e-6 x max |B|)
preflight_tests_stop_on_failure.T_corr: ck38 G-buffer: material id at every back-wall pixel == analytic checker from the hit position (pixels within 1 mm of a cell boundary excluded); mismatch fraction 0
preflight_tests_stop_on_failure.T_e2e: kmax = 1 render, common random numbers, original renderer (untextured) vs patched (ck38): textured / untextured e1 at lit back-wall pixels == albedo / 0.7 per cell (rel <= 1e-4)
preflight_tests_stop_on_failure.T_aware: ck38 and ck75 change the model's per-patch material input on exactly the back-wall patches whose id changed and nowhere else

visibility_check.rule: geometry only: camera rays hitting the panel (E2 T1), ideal mirror reflection about the panel normal, first hit; VISIBLE if >= 25 % of camera-visible panel pixels reflect the back wall and >= 2 cells of each parity are hit
visibility_check.preview: 64-spp reference preview of untextured / ck38 / ck75 (presentation only)
visibility_check.stop: NOT VISIBLE -> stop (making the reflection visible would require changing the transport / scene)

renders.reference: REF-ER, 4 realizations x 8,192 spp per variant, seeds 86100-86103 = the seeds of the WL86 untextured E2 T1 references r0-r3 (common random numbers: Lambert sampling and lobe choice do not depend on albedo, so paths are identical and only weights change)
renders.arms: own s8601 / s8602 x C0, C2_src, C2_rcv, C2_both, 2 realizations x 4,096 spp, seeds 86600 / 86601 = the seeds of the WL93D untextured arm renders (common random numbers)

outputs.sheet: per variant and seed: full frames (reference LOW + arm higher-order term), higher-order term only, panel close-ups with ROI contours, signed reference-relative higher-order difference (shared absolute scale), texture response textured - untextured of the higher-order term (shared absolute scale); one exposure keyed to the untextured reference median
outputs.numbers: descriptive only: region E_H (WL86 definition) in C, obj_panel, ROI_W (panel pixels whose mirror ray hits the back wall), back wall direct; texture-response slope / correlation / relative error vs the reference in ROI_W and on the back wall; reference half-split noise
outputs.labels: none. No verdict, gate or label is computed; the frozen WL93D labels are unchanged

not_done: no training, no checkpoint / operator change, no new transport mechanism, no image-space pattern, no protocol / verdict change of WL93D, no full-scale evaluation, no WL94
amendments_before_full_budget: A1 (after the dev smoke at 32 spp, before any full-budget render): T_identity compares with tolerance rel <= 1e-5 instead of bit-exactly, because pt86.accum sums samples with float atomics whose order varies between runs (measured orig-vs-orig floor 1.4e-7, equal to orig-vs-patched)
A2 (same time): T_e2e excludes pixels whose 3 x 3 G-buffer neighbourhood is not entirely back wall (jittered samples of silhouette pixels hit other objects; the failing pixels gave ratio 1.0)
A3 (same time, presentation only): the shared scale of the texture-response maps is the max over panel pixels (the directly seen wall saturates); figure titles shortened
chain fix: the GPU sampler loop is disowned (it was counted by the job pool and blocked the first dev launch)
amendments_after_full_results: A4 (POST HOC, after inspecting the full ck38 / ck75 results): the geometric (ideal-mirror) visibility rule passed (94 % of panel pixels reflect the back wall, 7 + 7 cells), but the radiometric reflection does not resolve the 25 cm checker: in ROI_W the textured / untextured median ratio of the reference LOW is 0.84 (even cells) vs 0.85 (odd cells) for ck38, where an ideal mirror would give 0.43 / 1.14 - the S1 lobe (alpha 0.026-0.075) at about 1.8 m averages several cells. Added variant ck38L: identical materials (ids 6 / 7) and code path, cells of 4 x 4 patches = 1 m (still patch-aligned, no transport or material change), with its own preflight and the same render budget. A reflection-parity metric (median ratio per checker parity of the mirror cell in ROI_W, for reference e2 / h / LOW and each arm's hl) is added to the descriptive numbers. The 25 cm results are kept unchanged.
